learning_outcomes.text: Defines the structure and operating principles of powertrains (clutches, transmissions, differentials, propeller shafts, etc.).
Analyzes the mechanical properties and design criteria of power transmission components.
Calculates torque, speed, efficiency, and endurance related to powertrains.
Compares mechanical, hydraulic, and electric powertrain systems and evaluate their appropriate applications.
Provides solutions to engineering problems arising in powertrains and to plan maintenance and repair processes.
